verdict.rationale: Docs show most billing actions (subscriptions, usage-based pricing, prorations, retries, invoicing, trials) are available via API as well as Dashboard, and Stripe ships CLI/MCP tooling for programmatic access [stripe-billing-docs-2, stripe-billing-docs-4, stripe-billing-docs-6, stripe-billing-docs-14, stripe-billing-docs-18, stripe-billing-docs-19]. However, several capabilities are described as Dashboard-only or Dashboard-first (customer portal activation/branding, no-code hosted invoice creation) with no explicit API equivalent cited, and community feedback notes gaps like plan management/email invoicing compared to competitors [stripe-billing-docs-8, stripe-billing-docs-13, stripe-billing-comm-6]. missing for 10: explicit API parity evidence for customer portal configuration and hosted invoice email flows, and independent confirmation of full UI/API feature parity.
